description: React component for Mattermost linking landing page, handling app/browser redirection, preferences, and UI rendering.

classes.name: LinkingLandingPage
classes.description: React component managing the linking landing page UI and logic for app/browser redirection.

methods.name: safeRedirect
methods.description: Sanitizes and constructs a safe redirect URL based on the current window location.

methods.name: checkLandingPreferenceBrowser
methods.description: Checks if the user has a landing preference set to open in browser.

methods.name: isEmbedded
methods.description: Detects if the page is embedded via iframe based on a specific cookie.

methods.name: checkLandingPreferenceApp
methods.description: Checks if the user has a landing preference set to open in Mattermost app.

methods.name: handleChecked
methods.description: Handles user toggling the 'Remember my preference' checkbox.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets user landing preference to app or browser based on input.

methods.name: openMattermostApp
methods.description: Redirects user to the Mattermost app URL.

methods.name: openInBrowser
methods.description: Redirects user to the web browser URL.

methods.name: renderSystemDialogMessage
methods.description: Renders message for system dialog based on device type.

methods.name: renderGoNativeAppMessage
methods.description: Renders link/button to open Mattermost app.

methods.name: getDownloadLink
methods.description: Returns the appropriate app download link based on device.

methods.name: handleBrandImageError
methods.description: Handles error when loading custom brand image.

methods.name: renderDownloadLinkText
methods.description: Renders text prompting user to download app based on device.

methods.name: renderDownloadLinkSection
methods.description: Renders section with download link or link to open in browser.

methods.name: renderDialogHeader
methods.description: Renders header for the dialog, including messages and download options.

methods.name: renderDialogBody
methods.description: Renders main body of the dialog with options and preferences.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the header with logo and optional custom branding.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, managing redirection and UI display.
